name: ETHIC
description: ETHIC is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to utilize long contexts effectively by measuring information coverage. It contains 1,986 test instances across four long-context tasks in books, debates, medicine, and law domains, highlighting challenges in managing extensive input contexts.
reputation: A recent long-context benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating information coverage across diverse document types, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Introduces a new metric, information coverage (IC), to quantify usable context; benchmark reveals significant performance drops in current LLMs on long-context tasks.
